title: Sam Crosses the Road
shortDescription: Help Sam get to the park safely!
description: Sam wants to get to the park on the other side of a busy road. Can you help Sam make safe choices on the way? There's no wrong way to learn: if a choice doesn't work out, you can always try again.

scenes.title: At the Curb
scenes.introText: Sam and Grandma walk to the edge of the road. The park is right across the street! Cars are driving past.
scenes.outroText: Sam really wants to go and play. What should Sam do first?

decisions.text: Stop at the curb and hold Grandma's hand
decisions.feedback: Yes! Stopping at the curb and holding a grown-up's hand is the safest way to start.

decisions.text: Run across as fast as possible
decisions.feedback: Running into the road is really risky, because drivers might not see you in time.

scenes.title: Beep Beep!
scenes.introText: Grandma gently pulls Sam back as a car beeps its horn. Phew! Everyone is okay. Grandma smiles and says, "Let's try that again, the safe way."
scenes.educationalNote: Always stop at the curb. Roads are for cars, and it can be hard for drivers to see small people.

decisions.text: Stop, hold Grandma's hand and try again
decisions.feedback: Great recovery! Trying again the safe way is exactly right.

scenes.title: Look and Listen
scenes.introText: Sam holds Grandma's hand at the curb. There's a crosswalk with a traffic light a little way along the street.
scenes.outroText: How should Sam and Grandma cross?

decisions.text: Walk to the crosswalk and wait for the green walking person
decisions.feedback: Perfect! Crosswalks and walk signals help everyone cross safely.

decisions.text: Cross between the parked cars. It's closer!
decisions.feedback: Parked cars can hide you from drivers. It's safer to use the crosswalk.

scenes.title: Hooray, the Park!
scenes.introText: The walking person turns green. Sam and Grandma look left, right and left again, then cross together. Sam runs to the swings. What a great day!

ending.title: Safe at the Park
ending.summary: You stopped, held hands and used the crosswalk. Road safety superstar!

scenes.title: Hmm, Not Quite
scenes.introText: Grandma stops Sam. "The drivers can't see us behind these parked cars," she says. "Let's walk to the crosswalk." Sam nods. Next time, Sam will remember!

ending.title: Almost There
ending.summary: Parked cars can hide you. Crosswalks are the safest place to cross.

achievements.title: Road Safety Star
achievements.description: Help Sam get to the park safely using the crosswalk.
